topics.title: Foundations, Data Preprocessing & Feature Engineering
topics.objective: Understand supervised learning paradigms, train/test splitting, and feature scaling techniques.
topics.exercise: Preprocess a tabular dataset with standard scaling and one-hot encoding using NumPy.

topics.title: Linear Regression & Cost Optimization
topics.objective: Derive gradient descent optimization and mean squared error (MSE) loss minimization.
topics.exercise: Implement batch gradient descent from scratch for univariate linear regression.

topics.title: Logistic Regression & Classification Metrics
topics.objective: Implement binary logistic regression with sigmoid activation and analyze precision, recall, and ROC-AUC.
topics.exercise: Build a binary classifier and calculate confusion matrix metrics.

topics.title: Decision Trees & Ensemble Methods
topics.objective: Master information gain, entropy reduction, and random forest bagging mechanisms.
topics.exercise: Train a decision tree model and compute Gini impurity across splits.
topics.example: gini = 1 - sum(p**2 for p in class_probs)

topics.title: Model Evaluation, Regularization (L1/L2) & Overfitting Prevention
topics.objective: Apply Ridge and Lasso regularization to mitigate overfitting and validate via k-fold cross-validation.
topics.exercise: Perform 5-fold cross-validation with L2 penalty tuning on a regression benchmark.
